caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented rectangular window with a pointed arch at the top, outlined by a double border. The window is divided into various sections by white mullions and muntins that form diamond-shaped and triangular panes. At the very top of the window, within the arched portion, there are two small circular shapes, one on each side. The background around the window is a beige color, while the window’s framing and inner grid lines are white or light gray. The outermost border is a darker gray, and the rest of the paper is a lighter cream or off-white color. There are no additional objects shown in the composition beyond the described window and surrounding borders.
title: Panel from Hall Lantern
